policies.title: Chad eVisa: Spanish, Swedish, Belgian, French, British-citizen, Dutch and Austrian ordinary passports
policies.summary: Each current passport-authority source establishes Chad visa liability for its named ordinary passport. Chad's later official rule makes the complete non-diplomatic/non-courtesy new-visa route exclusively electronic and pre-travel.
conditions: Applies only to short visitor travel on a full ordinary passport of Spain, Sweden, Belgium, France, the United Kingdom (British citizen), the Netherlands or Austria. It does not apply to diplomatic or courtesy visas, which remain with Chad's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

For new applications from 11 May 2026, evisa.td is the exclusive route. From 21 May 2026, a visa issued outside that platform does not permit entry; visas regularly issued before that date remain individually valid until expiry.

The portal states that Chad entry visas are delivered online and the circular requires an electronic dossier before the intended entry date. Apply no more than 60 days, and preferably at least 7 days, before entry; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing 72 hours, subject to further checks or congestion.

A valid passport, the required purpose-specific documents, payment, health proof including yellow-fever documentation where required, security review, any post-arrival registration and final immigration admission remain required. No visa on arrival or manual entry authorization is established by this policy.

Travel warnings, regional insecurity, work, residence, transit, crew, refugee, alien, service, diplomatic, courtesy, dual-nationality and other special-document routes remain outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

application.label: Chad official eVisa platform
application.processingTime: Standard: 10 working days; express: 72 hours; submit preferably at least 7 days and no more than 60 days before entry.
steps: Submit the eVisa application and a valid ordinary passport electronically before travel.
Upload purpose-specific supporting documents and pay as instructed; respond to any security or completeness request.
Travel only after electronic issuance and present the required health and travel documents for final admission.

conflicts.explanation: MAEC now expressly says ordinary-passport applications are online from 11 May 2026; Chad's controlling notice makes the new route exclusive. End-date canonical policy es-current-chad-advance-ordinary-visa for new applications at 2026-05-10.

Sweden's current mandatory-visa premise combines with Chad's exclusive new eVisa route; its Berlin-mission wording is superseded. End-date canonical policy sweden-to-chad-consular-visa-2026 for new applications at 2026-05-10.

Belgian guidance establishes visa liability, while Chad's later exclusive new eVisa rule supersedes its older Brussels-mission route. Surgically remove TD from canonical policy belgian-ordinary-passport-chad-liberia-niger-advance-visitor-visas; do not end-date its LR/NE scopes.

France Diplomatie confirms visa liability but its July consular-route wording conflicts with Chad's controlling May exclusive eVisa notice. Surgically remove TD from canonical policy france-ordinary-passport-named-advance-visa-routes; do not end-date its other destination scopes.

FCDO establishes the full British-citizen passport visa premise; Chad's later exclusive new eVisa rule supersedes the embassy route. Surgically remove TD from canonical policy uk-residual-advance-visa; do not end-date its other destination scopes.

Dutch guidance establishes visa liability for a Dutch passport; Chad's later exclusive new eVisa rule supersedes its Brussels-mission route. Surgically remove TD from canonical policy nl-outbound-advance-visa; do not end-date its other destination scopes.
